cooler: The snow-on-entry plus Slush Rush pacing works exactly as authored: Beartic moved first and took a KO on T2. The fight is short because the leads are 4x/2x weak to the obvious Fire/Fighting answer, which the crack line already admits. A Focus Sash or Sitrus on Medicham (not in this pass) would let Fake Out actually happen; no species change needed.
